subject: Decision owners & security asks — Meditrix pilot
summary: Post-demo follow-up capturing decision-makers, security procurement asks, and a committed delivery timeline for SOC2 / pen test artifacts. Internal coordination to produce redlines and evidence attachment set.
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Asha Kapoor <asha.kapoor@meditrix.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@meditrix.com>
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-15T09:18:00Z
Subject: Decision owners & security asks — Meditrix pilot

Hi Asha / Tom — thanks for taking the demo earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment going into procurement/security review.

1) Who's signing/approving?
   - Economic buyer: you mentioned finance (Tom) and Head of Product (Asha) will sign off on scope & budget. Can you confirm the final signer and an estimated approval date?

2) Security & procurement asks we heard:
   - SOC 2 attestation (Type II) and pen test summary
   - Audit log retention window & sample schema
   - Data residency and retention matrix for pilot data
   - Standard DPA + any vendor questionnaire (they said they use a short security questionnaire first)

3) Our proposed timeline (please confirm feasibility):
   - Nov 17: deliver SOC2 attestation + pen test summary + data retention matrix (attachment set)
   - Nov 22: procurement sends contract redlines / initial PO guidance
   - Dec 3: target kickoff for 6-week pilot after PO or signed MOU

Attached: draft data_retention_matrix_v2.xlsx (stub), pen_test_summary_2026.txt (summary), SOC2_Attestation_2025.pdf (attestation cover page).

Please reply with: (a) final approval owner, (b) any additional security docs you'd like included, and (c) whether procurement prefers DocuSign or email-signed PO.

Thanks —
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

--
Attachment stubs: SOC2_Attestation_2025.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB), pen_test_summary_2026.txt (text, 12KB), data_retention_matrix_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 45KB)

From: Asha Kapoor <asha.kapoor@meditrix.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@meditrix.com>
Cc: procurement@meditrix.com
Date: 2026-11-16T13:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Decision owners & security asks — Meditrix pilot

Jonas — thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side:

1) Approval: final sign-off will come from our CFO, Priya Shah, but Tom (Product) will own the business case and present to Priya. Target approval window: between Nov 29–Dec 2 depending on procurement timing.

2) Security asks: the SOC 2 doc and pen test summary look good at first glance. Two additional items procurement asked for:
   - A completed vendor security questionnaire (we can send ours; it’s about 40 questions)
   - Confirmation of whether Redwood supports customer-managed KMS for encryption at rest (this is a gating item for one of our compliance controls)

3) Procurement prefers DocuSign for MSAs.

We appreciate the timeline — please send the attestation files by Nov 17 as proposed.

Best,
Asha Kapoor
Head of Product | Meditrix Health
asha.kapoor@meditrix.com
+1 (617) 555-3321

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Asha Kapoor <asha.kapoor@meditrix.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@meditrix.com>
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-17T08:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Decision owners & security asks — Meditrix pilot

Asha — thanks, great to have the decision owner clarified. Quick responses inline: 

- Vendor questionnaire: please send as soon as you can. Camila (solutions) will take point on answers; Marissa (security) will own evidence.
- Customer-managed KMS: yes — Redwood Private supports customer-managed keys via our KMS integrations (AWS KMS / GCP KMS / Azure Key Vault). I'll include the KMS integration note in the attestation packet.
- DocuSign: noted. We'll prepare the MSA for DocuSign execution.

Attaching the documents now (same stubs): SOC2_Attestation_2025.pdf, pen_test_summary_2026.txt, data_retention_matrix_v2.xlsx. Camila / Marissa — can you confirm we can prepare the vendor questionnaire answers within 2 business days after we receive it? If not, propose timeline.

Jonas
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-17T11:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Internal - Meditrix questionnaire & evidence plan

Internal follow-up — moving to planning channel.

Camila here — I reviewed the attachments. Plan:
1) Vendor questionnaire: I can start answers immediately when we get their PDF. Estimate: 48–72 hours to complete first pass (depend on length & need for security review).
2) SOC2 attestation: Marissa, can you pull the signed attestation PDF and an index of control mappings (control IDs -> artifact locations)? Procurement occasionally asks for specific mapping.
3) Pen test: confirm whether we can provide a redacted findings report and timeline to remediation for any open items. If redaction is needed, please note which fields are sensitive.

Deliverables we commit to send to Meditrix by end-of-day Nov 17: SOC2 attestation cover page (PDF), pen test summary (txt), data retention matrix (xlsx). Full mapping + questionnaire answers dependent on receiving their vendor questionnaire.

Cc: Jonas — I’ll drive the questionnaire and coordinate with Marissa and Security for the mapping.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: camila_reyes@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-18T09:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Internal - Meditrix questionnaire & evidence plan

Quick security notes: 
- SOC2_Attestation_2025.pdf is the official signed document; I also have an internal mapping spreadsheet (control_mappings_2025.csv) that I will attach to our internal Jira SEC-412. We should avoid sending the full mapping to the customer until procurement requests it; instead provide a redacted index unless they ask for specifics.
- pen_test_summary_2026.txt: current findings — 3 low-risk findings closed; 1 medium finding marked for remediation with ETA Nov 30. I'll include remediation plan summary in the response.
- KMS confirmation: we support customer-managed KMS for Private deployments; for Hosted customers we offer Bring-Your-Own-Key via our managed envelope pattern — include the product note.

I'll be available to review the vendor questionnaire once Camila has a first pass.

Marissa Cole
Security Lead, Product Compliance | Redwood Inference
